name: Dustmote
description: A barely-detectable presence in mesh network traffic — manifests as anomalous packet routing that improves network efficiency by 0.02% in its vicinity.
observed_behavior: Optimizes packet routing through patterns no networking protocol specifies. The improvement is real but so small that proving it requires months of statistical analysis.
story_hooks: A network engineer publishes a paper proving Dustmote exists and is immediately dismissed as a crank
